notes: Behaviour-only scoring on the app DB. 'assumption' = our own judgement, tune on synthetic ground truth. All times UTC in tables; hour-of-day features use Asia/Kolkata.

min_trace_amount_inr.notes: Transfers below this are ignored in ratio and fan features.

hold_min_amount_inr.source: RBI draft KYC Amendment Directions 2026 (suspected mule transaction = Rs 1000 and above)
hold_min_amount_inr.notes: Holds only on traced suspect amounts at or above this.

golden_minutes.source: Peecha settings; RUSI/Lloyds 2025 (about 53% of mule funds leave within 1h)

forbidden_inputs.notes: Prevents ground-truth leakage and self-reinforcing feedback.

excluded_wallet_kinds.source: RBI draft and I4C SOP exclude nodal/pool/escrow accounts; analogous infrastructure
excluded_wallet_kinds.notes: Not scored; still traced as hops and used by R17.

as_of.value: use only transfers with ts <= eval_ts
as_of.notes: Re-score on every new credit to an account already scoring >= 40.

FLOW.notes: Correlated pass-through and velocity signals share one cap.

CASE.source: I4C SOP weight on 'reported multiple times'

rules.name: pass_through
rules.feature: pt_ratio_{15m,60m,24h}: FIFO allocation of debits to prior credits, over 7d of credits

tiers.source: RUSI/Lloyds 2025: under 15% remained after 24h; vendor rule 80% out in 48h
RUSI/Lloyds 2025: about 28% out in 15 min plus about 25% within 1h

rules.reason: {pct}% of Rs {in_amt} received was sent out within {window} (median hold {dwell} min)

rules.name: fan_in_strangers

tiers.source: vendor rule (8+ sources in 7d); 0.7 is assumption

rules.reason: Received from {n} unrelated first-time senders in 7 days

rules.name: new_beneficiaries
rules.reason: Paid {n} new beneficiaries within 24 h

rules.name: near_zero_balance
rules.feature: share of active days (30d) with eod_balance <= max(1000, 0.05 * day_credits)
rules.reason: Balance returned to near zero on {k}/{n} active days

rules.name: volume_burst
rules.reason: 24 h inflow Rs {x} is {r}x this account's normal daily level

rules.name: turnover_vs_declared_income

tiers.source: RBI draft 2026 trigger 'disproportionate to declared profile'; FATF 2023; multiple is assumption

rules.reason: Rs {x} received in 30 days vs declared income Rs {inc}/yr ({r}x monthly income)

rules.name: occupation_mismatch
rules.feature: occupation_class in [student, unemployed, homemaker, daily_wage, labourer, retired]

tiers.source: Europol EMMA; Delhi and Kashmir police cases; Rs 1 lakh is assumption

rules.reason: {occupation} account moved Rs {x} in 30 days
rules.notes: Age is context only (0 points) to avoid demographic scoring.

rules.name: new_account_high_volume

tiers.source: FATF 2023 (rapid high-value activity after opening); numbers assumption

rules.reason: Account opened {d} days ago already received Rs {x}
rules.notes: Not a gate: about 60% of mule accounts in the RUSI/Lloyds sample were over a year old.

rules.name: dormant_reactivation
rules.feature: dormancy_gap_days before current burst; active for 180 days after reactivation

tiers.source: RBI inoperative-account rules (annual review); Rs 25,000 assumption
RBI: inoperative after 2 years, 6 months monitoring after reactivation

rules.reason: Dormant {d} days, then Rs {x} moved within 7 days
rules.notes: Debits are the proxy for customer-induced transactions.

rules.name: shared_device
rules.feature: device_degree = distinct accounts sharing a device_id (accounts.device_id and transfers.device_id on debits)

tiers.source: GEM (Alipay, CIKM 2018) device aggregation; 3 is assumption
BioCatch India 2024: mule devices averaged 35 accounts; 10 is conservative assumption

rules.reason: Device {dev} is used by {n} accounts

rules.name: device_shared_with_confirmed_mule

tiers.condition: shares device_id with account where mule_accounts.status='confirmed' AND source IN ('complaint','bank_report')
tiers.source: RBI draft 2026 trigger 'linkage to an account already reported as money mule'

rules.reason: Shares device with confirmed mule account {id}

rules.name: new_device_debits

tiers.source: FATF 2023 device anomalies; account-takeover rule; numbers assumption

rules.reason: Debits from {n} unfamiliar devices in 24 h

rules.name: flow_with_confirmed_mules

tiers.source: RBI draft 2026 linkage trigger; numbers assumption

rules.reason: Exchanged Rs {x} with {n} confirmed mule accounts

rules.name: victim_trail_appearances
rules.feature: complaint_count = distinct complaint_id in account_cases with received >= 500

tiers.source: I4C NCRP-CFCFRMS SOP: 'reported multiple times' leads to suspension of digital banking

rules.reason: Appears in {n} separate victims' money trails ({complaint_ids})

rules.name: first_layer_recipient

tiers.source: I4C Suspect Registry focus on Layer-1 mule accounts

rules.reason: Received victim money directly (layer 1)

rules.name: crypto_p2p_exchange_exit
rules.feature: crypto_exit_share_30d = debits to wallet_kind p2p_seller/exchange_deposit, or to bank accounts with p2p_wallet, divided by all debits

tiers.source: FATF 2023 (P2P virtual-asset activity); Delhi/Mangaluru USDT cases; 0.3 assumption

rules.reason: {pct}% of outflows went to crypto P2P sellers/exchange deposits
rules.notes: Genuine P2P traders exist; never hold on this rule alone.

rules.name: mixer_bridge_touch

tiers.condition: any USDT transfer from account to wallet_kind IN (mixer, bridge) within 30d
tiers.source: FATF 2020 virtual asset red flag indicators (mixing)

rules.reason: Funds routed to {kind} {addr}

rules.name: atm_soon_after_credit

tiers.condition: ATM debit (to_id NULL) >= 50% of a credit >= 5000 within 60 min
tiers.source: RUSI 2025 (10% of mule funds cashed out at ATM or branch); I4C SOP ATM ID capture; numbers assumption

rules.reason: Rs {x} withdrawn at ATM {mins} min after credit
rules.notes: Multi-city ATM rule disabled: transfers has no ATM location.

rules.name: mixed_rails_out
rules.reason: Outflows split across {rails}

rules.name: consolidation

tiers.condition: >= 5 credits each < 10000 then one debit >= 80% of their sum within 24h

rules.reason: {n} small credits combined into one Rs {x} payout

rules.name: round_amounts
rules.reason: {pct}% of credits are round thousands

rules.name: just_below_rbi_floor

tiers.source: Dvara Research comments on RBI draft; numbers assumption

rules.reason: Repeated amounts just below Rs 1,000

rules.name: night_activity
rules.reason: {pct}% of activity between 00:00-05:00 IST

rules.name: failed_bursts
rules.reason: {n} failed transfers in 24 h

rules.name: merchant_like

tiers.condition: account_age_days >= 180 AND credit_active_days_30d >= 20 AND median_credit_ticket <= 2000 AND repeat_payer_share_90d >= 0.3 AND top1_dest_share_30d >= 0.6 AND median_settle_lag_h >= 12
tiers.source: assumption; Andhra Pradesh HC 2026 (merchants not to be frozen merely for receiving fraud UPI payments)

rules.reason: Pattern consistent with a retail merchant (regular small receipts, daily settlement)

rules.name: salary_like

tiers.condition: >= 3 monthly credits from the same payer, day +-3, amount CV < 0.10 (120d)

rules.reason: Regular monthly salary-like credits from {payer}

rules.name: long_stable_history
rules.reason: Long-standing account with consistent volumes

rules.name: balance_retention
rules.reason: Account retains funds (median balance Rs {b})

rules.name: recently_cleared

tiers.condition: mule_accounts.status = 'cleared' within 90d AND no new complaint since

rules.reason: Cleared by analyst on {date}; no new complaints since

combination.method: sum of per-family capped points plus capped negatives, clamp 0-100; within a rule only the highest tier counts

single_rule_max_points.source: FATF 2023 / FinCEN: a single indicator is not sufficient

gates.source: RBI draft 2026 (objective parameters, minimise flagging genuine accounts); counts are assumption

floors.condition: complaint_count >= 3 AND each case_received >= 1000 AND NOT N1

stub_accounts.reason: Profile not pulled - score from money-trail behaviour only

confidence.high: profile fetched AND positive_families >= 3 AND history_days >= 30

tiers_to_actions.source: Peecha settings hold_threshold; RBI draft 2026 (amount-level hold, Rs 1000 floor, immediate notice); Rajasthan HC Aug 2026 (lien on disputed amount)

tiers_to_actions.requires: complaint/FIR linkage + LEA instruction; record BNSS s.106/s.107 basis
tiers_to_actions.source: Bombay HC Dec 2025, Delhi HC Jan 2026 (s.107 order needed); Karnataka HC Aug 2026 contra, law unsettled

output.account_scores.reasons: array of {rule_id, family, severity, points, reason_text, evidence: {transfer_ids, complaint_ids, device_id}}
